source: 4. What is limiting progress? Capacity, latency, bandwidth, request throughput, instruction issue, synchronization, and compute throughput are different constraints. A kernel can fit comfortably in ZXNAME0000XZ and still spend most of its time waiting on memory movement.
zh: 4. 是什么限制了进展？容量、延迟、带宽、请求吞吐量、指令发布、同步和计算吞吐量是不同的约束。内核可以轻松地适应 ZXNAME0000XZ，并且仍然花费大部分时间等待内存移动。
